verdict.rationale: Ollama can be installed from a shell one-liner and exposes a REST API for running and managing models. Community users report running it on Linux for inference long before any GUI app existed there, using ROCm containers, and running it as a server backend for a Discord bot with model hot-swapping, which together show headless server use. missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on headless/daemon mode (e.g. a serve command or systemd/Docker setup), any evidence of CI-pipeline usage, independent corroboration of unattended server deployment.
